about.title: About Spootfind
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner in global product sourcing
about.storyContent: Spootfind was born from a simple idea: make global sourcing accessible to everyone. We connect buyers worldwide with trending products from top manufacturing hubs in China, Korea, Japan, and beyond.
about.missionContent: To democratize global trade by providing transparent, reliable, and efficient sourcing solutions for businesses of all sizes.
about.value1Desc: Every product and supplier is vetted for quality
about.value2Desc: Clear pricing, honest communication, no hidden fees
about.step1Desc: Explore our curated selection of top-selling products from Amazon, TikTok Shop, Etsy, and more.
about.step2Desc: Use our built-in calculator to see exact costs, shipping, and profit margins before you buy.
about.step3Desc: Contact verified suppliers directly and place your order with confidence.
about.storyExpanded: Founded in 2025, Spootfind started as a small team of former import-export professionals who saw countless small businesses struggle with the complexity of global sourcing. We built the platform we wished existed—one that brings transparency, speed, and reliability to cross-border trade. Today, we help thousands of entrepreneurs worldwide access quality products at competitive prices.
about.faqA1: We partner with verified manufacturers and trading companies primarily in China, South Korea, and Japan. Every supplier in our network is vetted for quality, production capacity, and export compliance.
about.faqQ2: What are the minimum order quantities?
about.faqA2: Minimum order quantities vary by product, typically starting at 20-50 units. We work with both small-batch buyers and bulk orders. Our platform shows exact MOQ for each product upfront.
about.faqQ3: How long does international shipping take?
about.faqA3: Shipping times depend on the destination country and shipping method. Air freight typically takes 7-14 days; sea freight takes 25-40 days. We partner with major logistics providers to offer competitive rates.
about.faqQ4: Is there a guarantee on product quality?
about.faqA4: We offer a quality verification service where our team inspects products before shipment for orders above $500. We also provide dispute resolution support if quality issues arise.

insights.art1_title: North America TikTok Fidget Toy Sourcing Guide (May 2026)
insights.art1_subtitle: Pop it, silicone balls & slime kits — sourced from China at a fraction of US retail price
insights.art1_hotTitle: 🔥 What's Selling Like Crazy Right Now
insights.art1_hotContent:
TikTok Shop is no longer just a video app — it's a $100B marketplace (2025 GMV) with **400M active shoppers**. And toys are one of its fastest-growing categories.

• **Pop It Fidget Sets** — #fidgettoy has **800M+ TikTok views**. One "mouse game" fidget toy sold **51,700 units in 30 days** on TikTok Shop alone ($82K revenue) - reported May 2026.

• **Silicone Stress Balls** — Amazon Best Seller, 4.6★. Routine impulse purchase at $8.99-$15.99 retail.

• **DIY Slime Kits with Glow-in-Dark** — Seasonal surge +340% week-over-week. Kids' birthday party staple.

• **360° Flip RC Cars** — TikTok Shop Top 50. The "unboxing factor" drives organic video content — buyers film themselves opening it.

**The demand picture is massive**:
- Global toy market: **$183B** (2025), with fidget & sensory toys as the fastest-growing sub-segment
- North America alone: **$42B+** toy market, impulse-driven, social-media-fueled
- TikTok Shop US GMV: **$19.98B** in 2025 (+165% YoY) — toys are top 3 category
- European & Australian markets following the same TikTok-driven demand curve

These aren't just toys — they're impulse purchases with 200-600% margins. And the demand isn't slowing down.
insights.art1_profitContent:
US retail: $8.99 – $32.99 per unit.

Sourcing cost from China? A fraction of that. We're talking 1/5 to 1/8 of retail price.

Even after shipping, duties, and your margin — you're still looking at 200-600% markup potential. That's not a typo.

**Real math:**
- Pop It set (10-pack): Retail $14.99 → Sourcing cost 1/6 of that → **~$12.50 profit per unit**
- Slime Kit with accessories: Retail $24.99 → Sourcing cost 1/5 → **~$20 margin per unit**
- RC Stunt Car: Retail $32.99 → Sourcing cost 1/8 → **~$28.90 margin per unit**

Scale that to even 100 units/month across 3 SKUs — that's **$5,000-8,000/month** in gross profit from a side hustle.

The catch? You need the right factory. Not every supplier on Alibaba delivers what they promise. That's where we come in.
insights.art1_regionContent:
China's manufacturing clusters for toys are unmatched anywhere in the world:

• Thousands of factories with complete supply chains — from raw silicone to finished product, all under one roof
• Export-grade quality that meets CE (EU), ASTM F963 (US), CPC certification standards
• Massive volume flexibility — whether you're testing with a small order or scaling to containers

**Who's buying these right now:**

🎯 **TikTok Shop sellers (US/UK)** — They need trending products fast. A video goes viral today, they need stock by next week. Speed of supply is everything. We match them with factories that can ship in 7-14 days.

🎯 **Amazon FBA sellers** — They need CPC/ASTM-certified products that won't get flagged. We verify certification before you order.

🎯 **Party & gift shop owners (North America, Australia)** — Fidget toys and slime kits are birthday party staples. A single shop can move 500+ units/month during peak season. At 1/5 of retail cost, that's serious margin.

🎯 **Boutique & indie brand creators** — Want custom colors, packaging, or private label? We connect you with factories that do OEM/ODM — not just white-label.

But here's what most people don't realize: the best factories don't always show up on the first page of Alibaba. The ones with the best price-quality ratio? They're often the ones you can't find on your own.

We've spent years building relationships with these factories. We know who delivers on time, who cuts corners, and who's worth your money.
insights.art1_tipsContent:
You focus on selling. We handle the rest:

• Match you with verified factories based on your product needs and target market
• Negotiate pricing on your behalf — we speak the language and know the real margins
• Inspect quality before shipment — not the showroom sample, the actual units going in the box
• Coordinate logistics so you don't have to figure out shipping, customs, or paperwork

No MOQ traps. No quality surprises. No midnight WeChat arguments with suppliers.

insights.art2_title: What's Hot in Global Sourcing (And How to Get In on It)
insights.art2_subtitle: Mini excavators are having a moment. Here's what you need to know — and how to move fast.
insights.art2_hotContent:
If you're in the construction equipment business, pay attention:

• **Mini excavators (1.8T-3T)** are the #1 exported construction machine from China in Q1 2026 — up 32.49% YoY. The buyers? Australia, Brazil, Indonesia, Vietnam, and — increasingly — the US and EU.

• **China's construction equipment exports hit $106.86B** in Jan-Feb 2026 (+33.4% YoY, data released Apr 2026). Exports to Africa surged **+77%**, Oceania **+50.6%**, Europe **+28.1%**.

• **Belt & Road markets are the growth engine**: 2026 Q1 exports to Belt & Road countries account for **64% of total**, up 24% YoY (reported May 18, 2026). Mining-driven demand in Africa (copper, gold, lithium, rare earths) means **75% of excavator demand comes from mining projects** (forecast 2026-2031). Kazakhstan road projects ordering 10+ units per site. Kenya infrastructure projects: 6+ units per contractor.

• **Saudi Arabia**: NEOM port is operational, $2B+ invested in port infrastructure alone. Active construction on 26,500 sq km smart city. Equipment demand is massive — and Chinese equipment is winning on price and availability.

• **Indonesia & Southeast Asia**: New capital Nusantara construction requires thousands of compact machines. Chinese equipment preferred for parts compatibility and lower total cost of ownership.

This isn't a trend. It's a structural shift. The question isn't whether demand is real — it's whether you're positioned to capture it.
insights.art2_profitContent:
If you're going to source compact construction equipment, here's why China is where you want to be:

**Price advantage**: A 1.8T mini excavator with genuine branded engine and CE certification costs a fraction of what you'd pay locally. Even after shipping, import duties, and your margin — the landed cost is still 50-70% below local retail.

**Who's buying and why:**

🌾 **Australian & NZ farmers** — Wheat, barley, cattle stations across WA, NSW, QLD. They need compact diggers for fence-post holes, irrigation trenches, land clearing, and stockyard maintenance. Local Cat/Kubota 1.8T: AUD 45,000-55,000. Landed Chinese equivalent: AUD 18,000-22,000 (RCM-certified, AS/NZS compliant). That's **60% savings**. And Australian farmers are dealing with 45°C summers, red dust, and the most demanding compliance standards on earth (RCM + AS/NZS). The right Chinese equipment handles all of it — at half the price.

🏡 **North American property owners & landscapers** — The "YouTube effect" is real. Videos of property owners unboxing Chinese mini excavators have 5M+ cumulative views. At this price point, it's an impulse buy, not a capital decision. A Texas rancher needs to dig fence lines, clear brush, maintain a driveway — doesn't need a $38,000 Cat. A $3,800 mini excavator does 80% of the job at 1/10 the price.

🏗️ **Belt & Road contractors** — Working on infrastructure projects in Africa, Central Asia, Middle East. They prefer Chinese equipment for parts compatibility — when a hydraulic hose fails on a project in Kenya, they need parts in days, not weeks. Chinese equipment + Chinese contractors = zero communication gap.

**Supply chain density**: China's manufacturing clusters mean engines, hydraulics, undercarriages, cabs — all sourced locally. Competition keeps quality up and prices transparent.

**Export-grade quality**: The "cheap but unreliable" reputation is outdated. Top-tier factories have spent years upgrading to Japanese hydraulic standards. Export-grade models now match spec — at a fraction of the price.

**But here's the thing**: Not all factories are equal. And if you don't know which is which — you're rolling the dice. Which is exactly why you need someone on the ground who does.
insights.art2_regionTitle: 🏭 We're On the Ground in China
insights.art2_regionContent:
We're not a marketplace. We're not a trading company. We're based in China, and we've spent years vetting factories so you don't have to.

Here's what we do:

• **Factory verification**: We visit in person. We check production capability, engine authorization, and spare parts availability. If they don't pass, we don't work with them.

• **Price negotiation**: We speak the language, we know the margins, and — because we work with multiple factories — we get you better terms than you'd get walking in cold.

• **Quality inspection**: We check the actual units being packed for shipping. Not the showroom unit. The ones going in the container.

• **Shipping coordination**: We handle logistics so your equipment arrives on time and on budget.

• **After-sales support**: When something breaks, you don't want to be arguing with a factory at 2am. That's our job.

We've vetted dozens of factories. Only the ones that passed our verification make it to our recommended list.
insights.art2_tipsContent:
If you're looking at the mini excavator market and thinking "I want in on this" — tell us what you're sourcing and your target market.

We'll send you:
• Our latest trend report (updated weekly)
• Factory-direct pricing for verified models
• Details on the factories we work with

Most of our buyers start with a test order, then scale once the first machine proves out. We grow with you.

Don't leave money on the table. The window on this trend won't stay open forever.

insights.art3_title: Southeast Asia E-Commerce Is Exploding: Sourcing Guide for Sellers (May 2026)
insights.art3_subtitle: TikTok Shop SEA GMV surged 125% in 2025 — here's what's selling and how to get in
insights.art3_hotTitle: 🔥 The Market Is on Fire (Data as of May 2026)
insights.art3_hotContent:
Southeast Asia is no longer a "cheap goods" market — it's a **$157.6B e-commerce economy** (2025 GMV, +22.8% YoY, reported Apr 2026 by Momentum Works).

TikTok Shop Southeast Asia is the fastest-growing channel:

• **2025 TikTok Shop SEA GMV: +125% YoY** (reported Jan 2026). The 12.12 mega sale drove cross-border GMV up **+493%** vs. prior year.

• **Country-level explosion**: Thailand +925%, Vietnam +614%, Malaysia +444%, Philippines +377% (12.12 event data, reported May 2026).

• **Every core category grew >120%**: computer & office equipment +5x, beauty appliances +3x, maternity & baby +3x, home textiles +3x, Muslim fashion +3x (TikTok Shop annual data, reported Jan 2026).

• **Quality upgrade is real**: average order value for top merchants rose ~40% over 2 years. Consumers aren't just chasing cheap — they want **value**.

• **Three platforms dominate**: Shopee + Lazada + TikTok Shop = **98.8% market share** (Momentum Works SEA E-Commerce Report, released Apr 14, 2026).

The window is open. But it's getting crowded fast — and the rules are changing.

**Specific cases that prove the hype (all from May 2026):**

• **False eyelashes** — One TikTok Thailand shop sold **140,000 pairs in 24 hours**. Light, low freight, high margin. No dominant brand yet — open playing field.

• **Skincare cream** — SSSKIN ID on TikTok Indonesia: two products hit **$233K and $184K weekly sales**. Beauty & personal care is the #1 category across SEA.

• **Velvet matte foundation** — $180K weekly sales on TikTok Indonesia. Makeup tools + skin prep = repeat purchase cycle.

• **HAN RIVER home appliances** — A Chinese brand on TikTok Indonesia: **81,000 units in 30 days**, $800K revenue. Proves Chinese products can win in SEA.

These aren't hypothetical. They're real numbers from the past few weeks.
insights.art3_profitContent:
Southeast Asia is geographically adjacent to China's manufacturing hubs. That means **shorter shipping, lower freight, and faster cash turnaround** than selling to the US or EU.

Here's what the math looks like:

• **Beauty tools & appliances** — Retail $12-$25 on Shopee/TikTok. Sourcing cost from China? **1/4 to 1/6 of retail**. Light, compact, high margin.

• **Muslim fashion & modest wear** — Huge demand in Indonesia & Malaysia. Retail $8-$20 per piece. Sourcing cost? A fraction. Volume orders compound the gap.

• **Home organization & storage** — The "home upgrade" trend is strong across SEA. Retail $5-$15. Lightweight, cheap to ship, impulse-friendly.

• **Kids' educational toys** — Indonesia's toy market is massive, but SNI certification is now mandatory (2026 new regulation). That's a barrier for sellers who don't know the process — and an advantage for those who do.

The key insight? **Proximity cuts logistics cost by 30-50% vs. US/EU routes.** That's extra margin most sellers leave on the table.
insights.art3_regionContent:
China is Southeast Asia's natural supply partner. Here's why:

• **Same-day samples** — Southern China factories can ship samples to SEA buyers the same day. US/EU sellers wait weeks.

• **Freight advantage** — Sea freight from Shenzhen to Jakarta: 5-7 days. To LA: 15-20 days. **3x faster** = 3x faster cash cycle.

• **Category breadth** — From beauty appliances to Muslim fashion to educational toys, Chinese factories produce the full range SEA consumers demand.

• **Platform-native supply** — Many Chinese factories are already optimized for TikTok Shop / Shopee packaging, labeling, and compliance. They speak the language of these platforms.

• **Scale flexibility** — Start with 50-unit test orders. Scale to 10,000 units. Chinese manufacturing can flex with your growth.
insights.art3_productsDesc: Products matched from verified Chinese factories to Southeast Asia's fastest-growing e-commerce categories.
insights.art3_tipsContent:
Southeast Asia isn't one market — it's six. Each country has different certifications, customs rules, and platform requirements.

You focus on selling. We handle the rest:

• **Certification & compliance** — SNI (Indonesia), TISI (Thailand), SIRIM (Malaysia) — we know which products need what, and we match you with factories that already have the certs.

• **Platform-ready products** — Labeling, packaging, and product specs optimized for TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada requirements.

• **Logistics coordination** — We work with forwarders who specialize in SEA routes. Sea freight, air freight, door-to-door — we arrange it.

• **Quality verification** — Every supplier we recommend has been vetted. We check production capability, sample quality, and track record before you place a single order.

• **Language & communication** — Our team bridges the gap between you and the factory. No miscommunication, no surprises.

The sellers winning in Southeast Asia aren't the ones who find the cheapest product. They're the ones who find the **right product with the right certifications at the right time.** That's what we do.
insights.art3_contactContent: Tell us which market you're targeting, what categories you sell, and your monthly volume — we'll send you a curated list of verified, certified factories with pricing.
